blob-sha-guide-1:
# Getting started

Install the widget catalog, then run `widgets serve`. The catalog lists every SKU with its price and stock level.
blob-sha-api-1:
# Widget API reference

`GET /widgets` lists widgets. `GET /widgets/{sku}` returns one widget with price and stock.
